channel.title: Just A Pinch Recipes - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Apricot Chicken
item.description: This easy-to-prepare apricot chicken will be a go-to recipe on a busy weeknight. We opted to use chicken breasts, but chicken thighs will work too. Once baked, the chicken is tender, tangy, and sweet. A delicious blend of flavors. Adding chicken broth to prepare the rice adds a bit of savory flavor. It's perfect with the sweeter chicken.

item.title: Guiltless French Fries
item.description: We could definitely eat an entire plate of these guiltless French fries. The potatoes are tossed in a fantastic seasoning that's a little smoky, savory, and sweet. Once baked, the potatoes are soft inside but slightly crispy outside. Since they're baked, not fried, and only use 3 Tbsp of olive oil, they are a healthier and tastier side dish.

item.title: Pot Roast
item.description: A classic way to prepare an old-fashioned pot roast with all the fixings. The roast becomes tender while simmering among beef bouillon, onion soup mix, and cola. If you don't want to use diet cola, regular cola or a can of broth will work well. The carrots and potatoes soak up all the yummy flavor of the gravy. A comforting slow cooker meal on a cold day.

item.title: Crock Pot French Dip Sandwiches
item.description: This Crock Pot French dip sandwich is a winner! The beef and veggies are tender and flavorful. On top of the bread is perfectly melted cheese. It's like a Philly cheesesteak but better. The best part is how easy this sandwich is to make. Just throw everything in the slow cooker and let it do its magic. Dip the sandwich into the flavorful au jus for an easy game day meal. Your kitchen will smell fab while this is cooking.

item.title: Mozzarella Cheese Yeast Dinner Rolls
item.description: These mozzarella cheese yeast dinner rolls are simply delicious. The roll itself is fluffy and buttery. Then, when you tear it open, there is a surprise of gooey cheese in the middle. Sprinkled on top is just the right amount of garlic and Parmesan cheese. These were perfect with a little marinara sauce as an appetizer, but they'd also be great alongside a pasta dish. They are Yummy with a capital Y!

item.title: Soft Chicken Taquitos and Southwestern Dip
item.description: Easy to prepare, these taquitos are a delicious appetizer any time of the year. The Southwestern dip is creamy and filled with spices. It has a nice kick. Make the dipping sauce a day ahead of time so the flavors can work their magic. Dipping the taquitos into the sauce adds a nice punch of flavor. The dip would also be delicious with potato chips. These taquitos would be great for a girl's night, game night, football party... so many possibilities!

item.title: Texas Trash
item.description: Wow, this dip is fabulous! We've tasted a lot of dips and this has quickly become a favorite. It's the ultimate bean dip. The bean part is smooth, creamy, and filled with Mexican spices. Then it's topped with thick layers of cheese. It's ooey gooey heaven. This will be great for any party. A real crowd pleaser.

item.title: Kitchen Sink Soup
item.description: Filled with flavor and textures, no one will miss a bit of fat when enjoying this healthier soup. Ground turkey adds a lean protein, and dicing up mushrooms bulks up the soup. Kale is nutrient-dense and has a nice flavor mixed with the sweet carrots. We loved the hint of smokiness from chopped bacon. With a bit of this and that, this homemade soup recipe can be thrown together pretty quickly, so it's great any night of the week when craving a warm and comforting bowl of soup.

item.title: Are You Kidding Cake
item.description: We can see why this dessert is named what it is. When people ask you how you made it and you tell them, they're going to say are you kidding me! We love how this is made with three ingredients (that are probably in the pantry already) and you can mix and match different boxed cake and pie filling flavors. We opted for lemon cake mix and blueberry pie filling and went with the extra inch on the hips version. The cake is nice and fluffy. The bits of cream cheese you get add a punch of tangy flavor

item.title: Creamy Chicken Cobbler
item.description: This creamy chicken cobbler is a hearty and comforting dinner on a cold evening. It has a filling like a creamy pot pie, but the topping is like a light and fluffy biscuit. Together each bite just melts in your mouth. Using a store-bought rotisserie chicken means you can have this weeknight meal on the table in under 45 minutes from start to finish.
